subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should provider quota become part of the generic reply-usage contract, and must it use prepared or cached provider state rather than a fresh lookup after every response?
rationale: The capability is feasible and vision-aligned, but maintainers must choose the hot-path lifecycle, polling frequency, and latency policy before implementation.

options.title: Use prepared quota state
options.body: Add optional active-provider quota data to the generic reply-usage contract and render it in enabled footers without a fresh reply-time lookup.

options.title: Fetch after each reply
options.body: Perform a bounded provider quota lookup during footer assembly and omit the field on timeout or failure.

options.title: Keep quota on demand
options.body: Leave provider quota in `/status` and keep response footers local-only.

recommendation.title: Use prepared quota state
recommendation.body: Add optional active-provider quota data to the generic reply-usage contract and render it in enabled footers without a fresh reply-time lookup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider-usage and reply-usage history makes this person the strongest available owner for the lifecycle decision.
